description: AAC, ALAC, and other patent-encumbered codec support on Desktop JVM via FFmpeg-Kit (GPL build) shipped through the org.bytedeco:ffmpeg-platform-gpl native bundle. Pulls bundled native binaries for macOS (arm64/x86_64), Linux (x86_64), and Windows (x86_64). LICENSE NOTICE: this artifact pulls GPL-licensed FFmpeg binaries; commercial consumers that ship soundscape-desktop-ffmpeg must comply with the GPL or substitute their own LGPL FFmpeg build.
